definition: לֹט noun [masculine] myrrh , or 'ladanum' (Greek), an aromatic gum exuded by leaves of cistus-rose, cistus villosus , Tristr FFP, 235, and especially Nat. Hist. Bib., 458 ff. ; Ri HWB 897 , compare Löw No. 79 Di Gen 37:25 Now Archaeology i. 64 (Sabean לדן , SabDenkm 84 ; Assyrian ladunu (from Damascus) compare Schr COT Gen 37:25 , MBAk. 1881, pp. 413 ff.; Arabic , whence Greek λήδανον , λάδανον Hdt iii. 112 ); — וּצְרִי וָלֹט נְכאֹת Gen 37:25 , merchandise of Ishmaelite caravan, compare Gen 43:11 , present to Joseph (both J ; ᵐ5 στακτή ).
